outer_radius = 40.0

result = outer - inner

num_ribs = int((width - 2*wall_thickness) // rib_spacing)
for i in range(num_ribs):
    y_pos = -width/2 + wall_thickness + rib_spacing/2 + i * rib_spacing
    rib = Pos(0, y_pos, wall_thickness + rib_height/2) * Box(length - 2*wall_thickness, rib_thickness, rib_height)

]
